From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@starmark.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP and EB meeting cadence for Starmark close

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Phillip and I walked away excited about the latency/cost profile you showed. Procurement wants a short mutual action plan and an EB (executive briefing) slot so we can get exec alignment and procurement sign-off. High level asks from our side: 

- A one-page MAP with milestones and owners (POC, security, legal, exec sign-off)
- Evaluation checklist (dataplane isolation, audit logs, SLAs, perf targets)
- Suggested EB attendees from Redwood (who should we expect in the exec meeting?)
- Proposed dates: we’re targeting contract sign by 2027-09-10, so ideally an EB the week of Aug 30 or Sep 6.

I attached our initial evaluation worksheet (Starmark_Eval_Details.xlsx). Can Redwood share a MAP draft and available EB windows? Also please call out any gating items that would push our timeline.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — our CFO wants this on the calendar by next Thursday.

Best,
Samantha Li
Head of Platform Partnerships
Starmark.ai

Attachment: Starmark_Eval_Details.xlsx (spreadsheet, 62 KB)

Hi Samantha — and thanks for sending the worksheet.

We can absolutely put together a focused MAP and an evaluation checklist tailored to your items. Quick answers up front:

- We’ll share a one-page MAP draft by EOD Tuesday (owners, milestones, success criteria).
- For the EB, our recommended attendee set (first pass): Rachel Kim (AM — product/close lead), Ben Carter (sales exec — commercial/terms), Marissa Cole (solutions/exec brief), and a short engineering presence (can be remote) if deep technical Qs come up.
- Gating items that could move your timeline: SOC 2 evidence exchange and network isolation checklist — those typically take 3–7 business days to validate if you need formal evidence.

Proposed EB windows (all in ET): Tue Aug 31 10:00–11:00, Wed Sep 1 14:00–15:00, Mon Sep 6 09:00–10:00. Which works best for your execs?

I’ve copied Ben and Marissa to help coordinate the MAP doc and pull together the short checklist. We’ll put a draft in Drive and share the link in the next message.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Rachel

Thanks Rachel — the proposed roster looks good. Confirming our execs for the EB:

- Daniel Park, CFO (will be primary decision owner for procurement)
- Priya Nair, CTO (technical sponsor)
- Phillip Grant, Head of Data (will join for evaluation questions) — cc’d on the calendar invites separately.

If SOC 2 artifacts are going to be requested, please note that our legal will expect an appendix with who from Redwood will have access to logs and the expected retention window.

Appreciate you moving fast on the MAP.

Cheers,
Samantha
